error.name: ambiguous_requirements
error.description: User requirements are unclear or incomplete
error.detection: - User provides vague descriptions without specific file paths - Multiple valid interpretations of the requested feature - Missing constraints or boundary conditions
error.resolution: - Ask focused clarifying questions with 2-4 actionable options - Document assumptions explicitly in plan.md - Do not proceed until critical ambiguities are resolved

example.question: Which specific login endpoint needs JWT integration?
example.options: 1) src/api/login/interface_login.py 2) src/api/login/interface_offline.py 3) Both endpoints 4) I need help identifying the right file

error.name: scope_violation
error.detection: - Sub-task touches more than 5 files - Sub-task estimated time exceeds 10 minutes - Plan includes implementation code
error.resolution: - Split large sub-tasks into smaller atomic units - Remove any implementation code references - Re-verify against 10-Minute Rule

error.name: cyclic_dependency
error.detection: - Task A depends on Task B, Task B depends on Task A - Dependency chain does not terminate
error.resolution: - Reorder tasks to ensure all dependencies reference earlier tasks - Validate DAG is acyclic before presenting to user

error.name: file_not_found
error.description: Referenced file does not exist in repository
error.detection: - File path in Input Contract returns not found - Directory structure does not match expectations
error.resolution: - Re-scan repository structure to find actual paths - Update plan.md with corrected file references - Do not guess; verify via directory listing

error.name: permission_denied
error.detection: - Read operations fail with permission errors - File access blocked by mode configuration
error.resolution: - Request user to adjust mode permissions if necessary - Document permission requirements in plan.md constraints

error.name: plan_not_approved
error.description: User has not approved plan before execution
error.detection: - User attempts to proceed without explicit approval - No sign-off detected in conversation
error.resolution: - Re-prompt for approval: "Plan generated at [path]. Please review and approve before implementation begins." - Do not proceed to execution without explicit confirmation

error.name: context_firewall_violation
error.detection: - Downstream agent references files outside context firewall - Task reads more context than specified in Input Contract
error.resolution: - Update context firewall definitions in plan.md - Ensure Input Contracts are precise and complete

procedure.name: unresolvable_ambiguity
procedure.trigger: Cannot resolve critical ambiguity after 3 clarification attempts
procedure.action: - Document all assumptions made - Present options to user with recommendation - If no response, proceed with most conservative assumption and document it

procedure.name: plan_drift
procedure.action: - Update Update Date in YAML frontmatter - Add Change Log section documenting what changed - Adjust remaining tasks accordingly - Re-request approval for modified plan

procedure.name: token_limit_approaching
procedure.trigger: Context window approaching exhaustion during planning
procedure.action: - Archive completed planning artifacts to agentic/plan/archive/ - Use rolling summaries instead of full conversation history - Reduce context firewall scope to minimum required files

self_correction.step: Identify the error category and specific error type
If failing after 2 correction attempts, escalate to user with documented options
